english.title: Consign animal / genetic material to another member State / bring into England without a signed health certificate

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[consigned an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), to]_
(B)_[consigned genetic material, namely **(..SPECIFY GENETIC MATERIAL..), to]_
(C)_[brought an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), into England from]_
(D)_[brought genetic material, namely **(..SPECIFY GENETIC MATERIAL..), into England from]_

another member State, namely **(..SPECIFY THE STATE..), which was not accompanied by a completed and signed health certificate required for that

(E)_[animal]_
(F)_[genetic material]_

in the relevant instrument specified in Schedule 1 to the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1), 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
consigned an animal / genetic material to another member State /
brought an animal / genetic material into England from another member State
which was not accompanied by a completed and signed health certificate required for that animal / genetic material
in the relevant instrument specified in Schedule 1 to the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For an offence committed on or after 14/12/19, see H20642

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
